recognize_zh: 成片黏著生長的大型細胞，核圓到卵圓、染色質空泡狀、核仁明顯、胞質豐富嗜雙色，並有多個分裂象；外觀像上皮或 ALCL，但需靠 CD20/PAX5 陽性證明為 B 細胞才能判定為 anaplastic 型 DLBCL。
features: Sheets of large cells, 3–4 times the size of small lymphocytes, with a cohesive growth pattern
Round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli
Moderate to abundant amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Frequent mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies
Only mild nuclear pleomorphism in this field; delicate intervening capillaries
describe_en: Section shows diffuse sheets of large atypical cells with a somewhat cohesive growth pattern. The cells have round to oval vesicular nuclei with prominent nucleoli and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; mitotic figures and apoptotic bodies are readily identified. Marked bizarre pleomorphism or hallmark horseshoe-shaped nuclei are not conspicuous in this field. The morphology is that of a high-grade large-cell lymphoma; with B-cell lineage confirmed (CD20/PAX5+), findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant, which may be CD30-positive and mimic ALCL or carcinoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows hallmark cells with strong uniform CD30 and T-cell/cytotoxic markers but lacks CD20/PAX5.
Carcinoma is cytokeratin-positive and CD45/CD20-negative despite similar cohesive sheets.
cHL cells are CD15+/CD30+ with weak PAX5 and absent CD45/CD20, set in an inflammatory background.
Plasmablastic lymphoma lacks CD20/PAX5 and expresses CD138/MUM1, often EBER-positive.
